Title: Aarav's Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Ananya - 12 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Pallavi - 37 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Ananya stand near him.]

Aarav: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aarav feeds the dog.]

Ananya: "Aarav, listen!"

[Aarav milks the cow.]

Aarav: "That was fun!"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Pallavi: "Hmm, I see."

[Aarav pats his horse.]

Pallavi (softly): "Okay, Aarav."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Ananya and Pallavi stand near him.]

Aarav: "What a nice place."

[Aarav combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Aarav: "Hmm, I see."

[Ananya puts on red lipstick.]

Ananya: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ananya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Aarav: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
